content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHAS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Report for registration at the Establishment Branch, DHAS Hospital on 12-11-2026 between 09:30 AM and 11:30 AM. Bring photograph, photocopies of qualifying certificates, date of birth proof, Photo ID card and address proof. Bring all original certificates for verification. Only candidates registered by 11:30 AM may appear before the interview board.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for DHAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 12 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DHAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 2 Senior Resident (Obs & Gynae), 2 Senior Resident (Surgery), 1 Senior Resident (Paediatrics), 1 Senior Resident (Radiology).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DHAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 12 November 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 yrs for General (as on date of interview). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, Persons with disabilities (Divyangjan) 5 years extra.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As per Pay matrix of Level 11 (Rs.67,700 – 2,08,700 ) plus allowances as admissible under the rules for Senior Resident (Obs & Gynae), As per Pay matrix of Level 11 (Rs.67,700 – 2,08,700 ) plus allowances as admissible under the rules for Senior Resident (Surgery), As per Pay matrix of Level 11 (Rs.67,700 – 2,08,700 ) plus allowances as admissible under the rules for Senior Resident (Paediatrics), As per Pay matrix of Level 11 (Rs.67,700 – 2,08,700 ) plus allowances as admissible under the rules for Senior Resident (Radiology).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with post graduate Degree/Diploma/DNB in the concerned specialty from a recognized University/Institution, valid registration with Delhi Medical Council, and must not have completed 03 years Senior Residency (regular and ad-hoc). If PG candidates are not available, minimum 03 years experience in the concerned specialty may be considered. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Valid registration with Delhi Medical Council. Must not have completed 03 years Senior Residency in any recognized institution, including regular and ad-hoc period. Services governed by residency schemes of Govt. of India Civil Services (Temporary Rules). Appointment subject to medical fitness and verification of certificates.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Registration at Establishment Branch (9:30 AM to 11:30 AM). Interview before the interview board. Interviews held after registration closes at 11:30 AM. Separate merit list for candidates who have completed 3 years residency.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ad-hoc appointment initially for 44 days. Extendable up to a maximum of 3 years with 01 day break after every 44 days, subject to satisfactory work and conduct report or till regular candidate joins. Total SR tenure 3 years including earlier SR service on ad-hoc/regular basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Dr. Hedgewar Arogya Sansthan, Karkardooma, Delhi.
